scripts.text: ^ff0000It seems that the type or weight of the item you have is too much. Please organize your inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000您攜帶的物品種類過多或負重過高，請先整理物品欄。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
If you bring automatic equipment and reinforcement modules, we can enchant the appropriate module on the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
帶來全自動裝備和強化模組，就能將對應的模組效果附加到裝備上。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
This is done according to the specification module, so the equipment will not be destroyed. However, the number of upgrades can vary depending on the module.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
強化使用標準規格的模組，因此裝備不會損壞。
不過，不同模組的強化次數上限也不同。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Then please visit again when you need help~
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
那麼，需要幫助時請再來找我哦~

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
If you bring automatic equipment and reinforcement modules, we can enchant the appropriate module on the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
帶來全自動裝備和強化模組，就能將對應的模組效果附加到裝備上。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
{0}.
Please select the grade of module that you want to use.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
{0}。
請選擇要使用的模組等級。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
You must possess a module in your inventory that matches the efficacy to proceed with the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
需要在物品欄中持有效果對應的模組，才能繼續強化。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Please make sure you have equipped the proper automatic equipment that you want to enhance.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
請確保您已裝備想要強化的全自動裝備。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
This automatic equipment is already at its maximum capacity.
Please try another automatic equipment.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
這件全自動裝備已達到最大強化等級。
請嘗試其他全自動裝備。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
You can not enchant this module to this automatic equipment.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
這件全自動裝備無法使用此模組附魔。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
This automatic equipment has already maximized the enhancement from this module.
Please try another module.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
這件全自動裝備已達到此模組的強化次數上限。
請使用其他模組。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Are you sure you want to enchance your ^FF0000{0}^000000 with ^0000CD{1}^000000? This process cannot be reversed.
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
您確定要為^FF0000{0}^000000使用^0000CD{1}^000000進行強化嗎？
此操作無法撤銷。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Woaaaah~ I can feel the power of your automatic equipment already~!
scripts.translation:
[麗莎]
哇啊~已經能感受到您全自動裝備的力量了~！

scripts.text:
[Cube Lane]
We are offering reinforcement cubes that will refine your ^0000CD+4^000000 Illusion and Automatic Equipment to ^FF0000+7^000000 in an instant!
Varmundt is no doubt the best man in the world!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
The bag is full. Please check the weight and number of items in your possession before talking again.
scripts.translation:

背包已滿。請檢查您持有的物品重量和數量後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
We accept Barmeal Tickets for upgrading your Illusion Equipment into Automatic Requipments.
What would you like to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[延青]
支付霸肋門德餐券，就能把幻象裝備升級為全自動裝備。
您想兌換什麼？

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
You can exchange your ^0000CD+9 Illusion Armor, Engine, or Leg and 900 Barmeal Tickets^000000 to ^FF0000Automatic Armor, Engine, or Leg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
用^0000CD+9的幻象機甲、推進翼或戰靴，加上900張霸肋門德餐券^000000，就能兌換對應的^FF0000全自動機甲、推進翼或戰靴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
The ^FF0000Automatic Accessories^000000 can be exchanged for ^0000CDIllusion Accessories and 1500 Barmeal Tickets^000000.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
想兌換^FF0000全自動飾品^000000，需要^0000CD幻象飾品和1500張霸肋門德餐券^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
The equipment you want to exchange must be in your inventory and talk to me.
^FF0000Bring only one equipment that you want to exchange and proceed.^000000
scripts.translation:
[延青]
請把要兌換的裝備放在物品欄裡，再來找我。
^FF0000每次請只攜帶一件要兌換的裝備。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
Have a nice day, dear guest~
scripts.translation:
[延青]
祝您有美好的一天，親愛的客人~

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
^FF0000Bring only one equipment that you want to exchange and proceed.^000000
If there are multiple equipments in your inventory, it will be exchanged randomly if it meets the condition.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
^FF0000每次請只攜帶一件要兌換的裝備。^000000
如果物品欄裡有多件符合條件的裝備，將隨機選取一件進行兌換。
